name: Dvoe v podzemel'e
source:
Each time, in every cycle, whenever madness broke out in the camp, he would run into the dungeons. They came to him, They found him - but not the right ones...
But one day, She came.
translation:
每一次，在每一个轮回里，每当疯狂席卷整座营地时，他都会逃进地下迷宫之中。“她们”向他走来，“她们”找到了他——却都不是对的那个人……
直到某一天，“她”来了。
